items: [2025 Android 16 Tablet with Octa-Core Processor] This new 11-inch tablet comes with the fast, intelligent and secure Android 16 operating system and a powerful built-in T615 octa-core processor for smooth and efficient streaming. No more redundant software troubles. Enjoy a more personalised setup experience with widgets, a split-screen function, parental controls and multi-user features. Data encryption, user rights and notification management functions fully protect your privacy and security.

[11-inch IPS display + Widevine L1 certification] The Relndoo tablet features an 11-inch IPS display that provides a realistic visual experience with clear details. With Widevine L1 certification, it supports 1080p HD video playback on Netflix and other platforms. The wireless casting function allows you to easily connect to a big-screen TV. The independent 3.5 mm headphone port allows charging and music playback without any interference, meeting a variety of needs.

[Massive storage & dual camera] This tablet with keyboard has 20 GB (4 GB of physical memory + 16 GB of smart memory) and 128 GB of storage space, which can be expanded up to 1 TB via a TF card (not included). This provides superior performance when operating applications compared to similarly priced 11-inch Android tablets. The 8 MP front-facing camera and 13 MP rear camera with autofocus and flash make video conferencing and everyday shooting easy.

[All-in-one productivity and entertainment] The Higrace 2-in-1 tablet kit instantly transforms your tablet into an all-in-one workstation! It includes a Bluetooth keyboard, mouse, protective case and stylus — everything you need is in one box. Easily switch between tablet mode and notebook mode anytime, anywhere. Perfect for handling office tasks, studying and reading.
